description: Official event posters found for upcoming cards and looked at by eye before they were kept. scripts/cache-event-posters.py reads this file alongside data/upcoming-cards.json and data/historical-posters.json, so a poster can be cached without rewriting the schedule. One entry per event id; width/height are the original image's own size and orientation is its shape. Rights basis: the owner's attestation of 2026-11-24 for official event posters from boxing and MMA promoter, broadcaster and fight-schedule sites (docs/design/IMAGE-GUIDE.md, Event posters).
attestation: owner 2026-11-24: official event posters from boxing and MMA promoter, broadcaster and fight-schedule sites (Top Rank included)
